From Middle High German verdrieȥen, from Old High German firthrioȥan, ultimately from Proto-Germanic *firi- + *þreutaną (“to harass”).

verdenken.et: From Middle High German verdenken, from Old High German firthenken, from Proto-West Germanic *fraþankijan. Equivalent to ver- + denken. Compare Dutch verdenken and Old English forþencan.
